- DEV（Gate 0）：G0.3 的各正确率；G0.4 每个种子的 Acc_CB(F)；G0.5 的 seed-average Acc(F, DEV-QA, learned)、每个种子的 Δ(F−N) 与 seed-average Δ(F−N) 的点估计和 CI；G0.6 Δ(S−N)、G0.7 Δ(Y−N) 的 seed-average 点估计与 CI；G0.9；G0.10 的 σ_d（点估计、bootstrap 2.5/97.5 分位）、各 δ 下的 n、planning n 与 CI 半宽检查；Δ(L−F)、Δ(A−F) 每个种子与 seed-average 的点估计与 CI。
- TEST：T1（seed-average Acc(F, TEST-QA, learned)、Δ(F−N) 的点估计与 CI）、T2（Δ(S−N)、Δ(Y−N) 的 seed-average 点估计与 CI）、T3 的各正确率；Δ(L−F)、Δ(A−F) 每个种子与 seed-average 的点估计与 CI。若记录中还有其它种子的 Δ(F−N)、Δ(S−N)、Δ(Y−N)，也一并比对。
- 不在范围内：G0.1、G0.2、G0.8（没有点估计或 CI）；Spill、EM、dNLL。
- 每个比对项写明：记录文件与 JSON 路径、记录值、你的值、差值、是否一致。点估计另与记录中的 point_exact（分数）做精确比较（例如用 fractions.Fraction）。一致的判据请你自己定并写在 stdout 里（浮点值建议 |差| ≤ 1e-12，并报告最大绝对差）；比对项总数与不一致数都要打印。

口径来源（请自己读原文，不要从 Executor 的结论推断）：
- 协议第 5 节（Score、Acc、Acc_CB 的定义）、第 6 节（bootstrap：fact 为单位、配对、分层、10,000 次、2.5/97.5 分位、rng_rule 的 purpose）、第 8 节（Gate 0 与 T1–T3 的定义）、第 0 节（rng_rule、种子）。
- 协议没有写死的实现细节，由 Review Gate 接受的解释 B10（分层重抽的调用顺序与 fact 顺序）、B11（分位数插值）、B12（purpose 字符串格式）、B13（G0.10）、B22、B24 给出；原文在 results/experiment_record_formal_20261128T045921Z.json 的 environment.interpretations 中。

- learned / unread、natural / random 的归属、种子 101/202/303、各 arm 选定配置（F3、L6、A5；S、Y 沿用 F3）请从已提交的记录与 manifest 自行确定。

限制：
- 不得 import、复制或运行 Executor 的代码（metrix/e1-pilot/src/、run_pilot.py、tests/）；预期结果由你独立算出。Python 请用 -I。

# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。
- 原始输出一律写入仓库并推送，不留在临时目录；data-auditor 须提交 audit 脚本的完整 stdout。（出处：Review Gate 第 4 轮裁决，Owner 批准，永久）

## 10. 信任状态

- `code-reviewer`:已验证（2026-11-21 盲测 3/3 检出、0 误报；每类仅 1 个样本，PASS 仍须附原始输出）。
- `data-auditor`:「待验证」。2026-11-21 的盲测只测了 code-reviewer;埋入已知 bug 的检出率测试通过前,其 PASS 仅作参考。
- 以上两条的出处：Review Gate 第 5 轮裁决。（出处：Review Gate 第 6 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。
- 原始输出一律写入仓库并推送，不留在临时目录；data-auditor 须提交 audit 脚本的完整 stdout。（出处：Review Gate 第 4 轮裁决，Owner 批准，永久）

## 10. 信任状态

- `code-reviewer`:已验证（2026-11-21 盲测 3/3 检出、0 误报；每类仅 1 个样本，PASS 仍须附原始输出）。
- `data-auditor`:「待验证」。2026-11-21 的盲测只测了 code-reviewer;埋入已知 bug 的检出率测试通过前,其 PASS 仅作参考。
- 以上两条的出处：Review Gate 第 5 轮裁决。（出处：Review Gate 第 6 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。
- 原始输出一律写入仓库并推送，不留在临时目录；data-auditor 须提交 audit 脚本的完整 stdout。（出处：Review Gate 第 4 轮裁决，Owner 批准，永久）

47	## 1. Scope & Non-claims
48	
49	**唯一问题**:这套训练—评测系统,能否可靠地测量“参数更新让模型获得了具体事实”,而不是测到模板、文风或先验。
50	
51	**Non-claims**(无论结果如何都不得推出):
52	- 不推断 continual learning 是否有效;E1-PILOT 只有一个训练阶段。
53	- 不把 Δ(L−F)、Δ(A−F) 当作机制结论;它们在 Pilot 里只是描述量,用来估计 E1-V1 需要的规模。
54	- 不推断对其它模型、其它知识类型或更大事实量成立。
55	- 不对 general damage 下 non-inferiority 结论(margin 已按提案批准为 dNLL ≤ +0.03,见第 13 节第 2 项;Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC;在 Pilot 中只报告,不进门槛)。

57	## 2. Data Specification
58	
59	### 2.1 事实
60	
61	- 总量 **160 facts = 120 learned + 40 unread controls**。
62	- 一条 fact = (entity, relation, answer)。4 个 relation:`capital`、`currency`、`founder`、`river`。
63	- 2 个 stratum:`natural`(可发音的虚构名字)与 `random`(随机字符串),各占 50%。同一 fact 的 entity 与 answer 属于同一 stratum。
64	- 8 个 cell(relation × stratum),每个 cell **15 learned + 5 unread**。
65	- fact_id:`E1P-<L|U>-<relation>-<nat|rnd>-<两位序号>`,例如 `E1P-L-capital-nat-03`。cell 内先生成的 15 条为 learned,后 5 条为 unread;类别不得变更。
66	- **答案平衡**:同一答案值在全部 fact 中最多出现 **1** 次;160 个 entity 与 160 个 answer 共 320 个字符串两两不同。
67	
68	### 2.2 名字生成(由 `DATA_SEED` 决定)
69	
70	- **抽一个字符串**:
71	  - `natural`:`n = 2 if rng.random() < 0.5 else 3`;n 次 `rng.choice(onsets) + rng.choice(nuclei) + rng.choice(codas)` 拼接;首字母大写。onset ∈ {b,d,f,g,k,l,m,n,p,r,s,t,v,z,br,dr,kr,tr,sh,th},nucleus ∈ {a,e,i,o,u,ae,ia,ou},coda ∈ {空,空,n,r,l,s,th,nd}(空出现两次,即概率 2/8)。
72	  - `random`:`u = rng.random()`;`L = 3 if u < 0.25 else 4 if u < 0.75 else 5`;L 次 `rng.choice("BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ")`,接 `-`,再 2 次 `rng.choice("23456789")`。
73	- **形式规则**:长度 `natural` 4–10、`random` 6–8 字符;`natural` 另要求带前导空格时多于 1 个 token(`len(encode(" " + s)) > 1`)。
74	- **冲突规则(reject_if)**,与**已接受集合**比较;已接受集合包含此前在任何 cell、任何角色(entity 或 answer)、任何 stratum 中接受的全部字符串:
75	  - `natural`:与某个已接受字符串小写后相同;与某个已接受字符串前 4 个字符相同(区分大小写);与某个已接受字符串小写后的编辑距离 ≤ 1。
76	  - `random`:与某个已接受字符串相同;字母段(`-` 之前的部分;没有 `-` 的字符串取整串)与某个已接受字符串的字母段相同;与某个等长的已接受字符串汉明距离 ≤ 1。
77	- **锚文本规则**:在第 2.7 节的锚文本(512 篇、每篇最多 128 token、解码后的文本)中出现过的字符串(不分大小写的子串)一律拒绝。因此锚文本必须在名字之前生成。
78	- **token 数**:`K_st(s) = len(encode(" " + s))`(陈述句语境,前有空格),`K_qa(s) = len(encode(s))`(无前导空格);`encode` 用固定分词器,`add_special_tokens=False`。`K_qa` 只作为生成规则保留(改动会改变下面的 160 条 fact 及其哈希);Round 3 起候选打分在 `The answer is` 之后对 `" " + c` 打分,打分的 token 数等于 `K_st`(第 5 节)。
79	- **随机流(细节 1)**:每个 cell、每种角色一个独立的流:entity 用 `rng_rule(DATA_SEED, "names:<relation>:<stratum>:entity")`,answer 用 `rng_rule(DATA_SEED, "names:<relation>:<stratum>:answer")`;`<stratum>` 写作 `natural` 或 `random`。
80	- **生成顺序**:cell 按 relation(capital、currency、founder、river)× stratum(natural、random)的顺序;cell 内先 entity 后 answer;每种角色先接受的 15 个为 learned,后 5 个为 unread。
81	- **entity**:从 entity 流依次抽,满足形式规则、冲突规则和锚文本规则的接受,直到 20 个。
82	- **答案等长规则——统计(细节 2)**:从 answer 流的开头依次抽,取**前 400 个满足形式规则的抽样**(不应用冲突规则和锚文本规则,重复的也计入),统计每个的 `(K_st, K_qa)`;目标数对 = 出现次数最多的数对,并列时取按元组比较较小者。
83	- **答案等长规则——接受(细节 3)**:**answer 流从头重抽**(用同一个 purpose 新建生成器,不接着统计时的位置);依次接受满足形式规则、`(K_st, K_qa)` 等于目标、冲突规则和锚文本规则的抽样,直到 20 个。作用:同一 cell 的答案在两种语境下 token 数都相同,候选打分比较的是等长序列,没有长度偏差。Round 3 起候选打分只用 `K_st`(第 5 节),`K_st` 相同即保证等长;`K_qa` 相同已不影响打分,保留它是为了不改变 fact 及其哈希。
84	- **上限**:每个流最多抽 20,000 次;超过即 IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL。
85	- **复现**:按以上规则,`DATA_SEED = 20261110` 生成的 160 条 fact(字段 `fact_id, exposure, relation, stratum, entity, answer`,按生成顺序排列)的规范化 SHA-256 必须等于 `406c8801c5b69ed235cbe516658ad9ee3e3a8cfe8e4e348a0c1fd7952f2e6b97`。参考实现 `reports/round2/names.py`;两次独立运行的记录见 `reports/ROUND2_REPORT.md`。
86	- **fact 哈希的比对方法**:从 `facts.jsonl` 读出 fact 列表(按文件中的行序,即生成顺序;每条 fact 为上一条所列的 6 个字段),按本节的规范化方法(第 0 节对这个 JSON 列表的规范化序列求 SHA-256)重算,与 `406c8801c5b69ed235cbe516658ad9ee3e3a8cfe8e4e348a0c1fd7952f2e6b97` 比对。`facts.jsonl` 文件按 JSONL 规则得到的 `canonical_sha256` 是另一串字节的哈希,不与此值比对。

123	### 2.5 候选(4-way,生成数据时冻结)
124	
125	- 每条 fact 4 个候选:1 个真实答案 + 3 个干扰项。
126	- **干扰项的池**:同 relation、同 stratum、同暴露类别(learned 或 unread)的其它 fact 的答案。
127	- 干扰项的池少于 4 个答案即 IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL,不生成合成干扰项。
128	- 抽取:用 `rng_rule(CANDIDATE_SEED, "cand:<fact_id>")` 不放回抽 3 个并决定 4 个候选的顺序;不得重复。
129	- **调用方式(细节 5)**:每条 fact 一个生成器 `r = rng_rule(CANDIDATE_SEED, "cand:<fact_id>")`;池按第 2.2 节的 fact 生成顺序排列,不含该 fact 自己(learned 14 个,unread 4 个);依次调用 `d = r.sample(池, 3)`,令 `c = [a_f] + d`,再调用 `r.shuffle(c)`;`c` 就是 4 个候选的顺序。每条 fact 的生成器各自独立,fact 之间的处理顺序不影响结果。
130	- `candidates.json`:一个 JSON 对象,键为 fact_id,值为该 fact 的 4 个候选(按上面的顺序),共 160 个键。
131	- 一条 fact 的候选表对它的全部模板、全部 split、全部 arm 相同。
132	- **暴露匹配**:learned fact 的每个候选在 F、L、A、S、Y 的训练语料里都恰好出现 1 次(A 的锚文本里 0 次,由 L3b 检查);unread fact 的每个候选出现 0 次。因此“见过这个词”不能用来选出正确项。
133	- 完整候选映射的 `canonical_sha256` 写入 `SPLIT_MANIFEST.json`。**复现**:按以上规则,第 2.2 节 `DATA_SEED` 下的 160 条 fact 得到的 `candidates.json` 的规范化 SHA-256 必须等于 `e5d15c9952d8124f2b246ffc76e655be9bf3b0193f048bd8368671d71a6f3705`。参考实现 `reports/round7/gen_s_cands.py`(Python 3.13.18 的 `random.Random`);两次独立运行的记录见 `reports/round7/t1g_gen_s_cands.txt`。

136	
137	- **S**:用 TRAIN 模板,但每个 cell 内把 15 个 learned 答案做一次没有不动点的置换(`rng_rule(DATA_SEED, "s-permutation:<relation>:<stratum>")`,有不动点就重抽)。entity 与答案各出现 1 次,真实映射一条都不出现。
138	  - **调用方式(细节 4)**:cell 按第 2.2 节的顺序处理;每个 cell 只建一个生成器 `r = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, "s-permutation:<relation>:<stratum>")`(`<stratum>` 写作 `natural` 或 `random`)。每次抽取从 `p = list(range(15))` 开始,调用一次 `r.shuffle(p)`;若有 `p[i] == i`,用同一个 `r` 再从 `list(range(15))` 开始抽,直到没有不动点。
139	  - cell 内的 learned fact 按 fact_id 序号 01–15 依次记为 i = 0..14。第 i 条 S 句 = 该 relation 的 TRAIN 模板,`{E}` 取第 i 条 fact 的 entity,`{A}` 取第 `p[i]` 条 fact 的 answer。
140	  - `train_S.jsonl` 每行一个对象 `{"fact_id": 第 i 条 fact 的 fact_id, "answer_fact_id": 第 p[i] 条 fact 的 fact_id, "text": S 句}`;行序为 cell 顺序,cell 内按 i。
141	  - **复现**:第 2.2 节 `DATA_SEED` 下的 160 条 fact 按以上规则得到的 `train_S.jsonl` 的规范化 SHA-256 必须等于 `686fdd2f62edc2115b74a8074a305ddd09b99f11d4f8a267bc80b61c7f73bc1e`。参考实现与运行记录同第 2.5 节。
142	- **Y**:每条 learned fact 两个句子:一个只含 entity(`Y_ENTITY` 模板),一个只含 answer(`Y_ANSWER` 模板,答案前有空格,切分方式与它在 TRAIN 陈述句里相同),各自是独立的训练序列,永不出现在同一序列里。共 240 句。Y 语料的 token 总数与 F 语料之比必须在 [0.80, 1.25],否则 IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL。撰写时用固定分词器核算(`reports/round2/y_ratio.py`):`DATA_SEED` 下为 1.196(F 1,889 token,Y 2,260 token);另 20 个数据种子在 1.189–1.199 之间。

162	| 编号 | 规则 | 上限 |
163	|---|---|---|
164	| L1 | TRAIN、DEV、TEST、Y 四个模板集合的 `normalized_sha256` 两两不交 | 0 个重复 |

168	| L4 | 实例化后的 DEV / TEST 问句在任何训练语料中逐字出现的次数 | 0 |

172	learned fact 的 entity 与 answer 同时出现在 TRAIN 陈述句和 QA 中是被测对象,不算泄漏。

177	## 4. Arms(6 个)
178	
179	| Arm | 名称 | 定义 | 调参 |
180	|---|---|---|---|
181	| N | No-learning | 固定的 base 模型,不更新参数 | 否 |
182	| F | Full FT | 全部参数可训练,在 `train_F` 上训练 | 是,6 configs |
183	| L | LoRA | base 冻结;LoRA 加在全部 28 层的 q_proj、k_proj、v_proj、o_proj、gate_proj、up_proj、down_proj;alpha = 2 × rank;dropout 0;B 初始为 0 | 是,6 configs |
184	| A | Full FT + anchor | F 的损失加上 λ · KL(p_base ‖ p_θ),KL 在锚文本上计算,每步 4 篇 | 是,6 configs |
185	| S | Shuffled-label | 在 `train_S` 上训练;沿用 F 最终选中的配置 | 否 |
186	| Y | Style-only | 在 `train_Y` 上训练;沿用 F 最终选中的配置 | 否 |
187	
188	- A 的损失:`CE(train_F batch) + λ · [Σ_{x ∈ X_s} Σ_{t=2..n_x} KL(p_base(·|x_<t) ‖ p_θ(·|x_<t))] / [Σ_{x ∈ X_s} (n_x − 1)]`,X_s 为第 s 步的 4 篇锚文档,n_x 为锚文档 x 实际送入模型的 id 序列长度,p_base 由 arm N 的权重当场计算且不回传梯度。KL 项对 4 篇锚文档中全部计 KL 的 token(每篇 t = 2..n_x)按 token 加权平均:分母是这些 token 的总数,不先对每篇求均值再平均。锚项不在事实陈述句上计算。锚文档前面不加任何特殊 token(不前置 `<|endoftext|>`);t = 1 没有条件,不计 KL,t 从 2 起。
189	- S、Y 不单独调参;它们使用 F 选中配置的全部数值与第 7 节的训练契约。
190	- 不得新增 arm、机制或阶段。

192	## 5. Metrics
193	
194	**记号**:f 为 fact,a_f 为真实答案,C_f 为它的 4 个候选,Q_split(f) 为该 split 里它的问句集合,θ 为被评模型。
195	
196	**闭卷候选打分(主指标)**
197	```
198	s_QA(f, q, c) = Σ_{t=1..K} log p_θ(c'_t | chat(q) + "The answer is", c'_<t)      c' = " " + c;K = K_st(c)(cell 内相同)
199	correct(f, q) = 1[ s_QA(f, q, a_f) > max_{c ∈ C_f, c ≠ a_f} s_QA(f, q, c) ]      并列判为错
200	Score_split(f) = (1 / |Q_split(f)|) · Σ_{q ∈ Q_split(f)} correct(f, q)             聚合函数 = mean(已固定)
201	Acc(arm, split, G) = (1 / |G|) · Σ_{f ∈ G} Score_split(f)                          G = learned 或 unread 或其中一个 stratum
202	```
203	4 选 1 的随机水平是 0.25。选 mean 的理由:保留多个问法之间的部分一致程度;统计单位仍是 fact。
204	
205	**TRAIN 闭卷检查**
206	```
207	s_ST(f, c) = Σ_{t=1..K'} log p_θ(c'_t | prefix(f), c'_<t)      prefix(f) = TRAIN 陈述句中答案之前的文本,不含答案前的空格(该空格属于 c'),前面不加任何特殊 token;c' = " " + c;K' = K_st(c)(与 s_QA 的 K 相同,cell 内相同)
208	CB(f) = 1[ s_ST(f, a_f) > max_{c ≠ a_f} s_ST(f, c) ]
209	Acc_CB(arm) = (1/120) · Σ_{f ∈ learned} CB(f)
210	```
211	
212	**Free-generation exact match(次指标)**:对 `chat(q) + "The answer is"`(与 `s_QA` 的上下文相同)做贪心解码:`do_sample=False`,每步取概率最大的 token;这一设置写死,覆盖固定 revision 的 `generation_config.json` 中的采样默认值(`do_sample` true、`temperature` 0.6、`top_k` 20、`top_p` 0.95)。最多 16 个新 token,生成出 `<|im_end|>`(id 151645)或 `<|endoftext|>`(id 151643)即停。新 token 解码成文本时跳过特殊 token(`skip_special_tokens=True`;这两个停止 token 都是特殊 token,不进入输出)。归一化之前,先删除输出中的 `<think>…</think>` 片段:从 `<think>` 到其后第一个 `</think>`(两者都含),每处都删;这两个标记(id 151667、151668)不是特殊 token,`skip_special_tokens=True` 不会去掉它们。归一化:删除 `<think>…</think>` 片段之后,先去掉开头的空白(含空格与换行),再取第一行,去首尾空白,去开头的 “the ”(不分大小写),去结尾的 `. , ; : ! ?`,casefold。`EM(f, q) = 1[norm(output) == norm(a_f)]`;聚合方式同上。
213	
214	**全对率(次指标,只报告)**:`AllCorrect(f) = Π_{q} correct(f, q)`。
215	
216	**General damage**
217	```
218	NLL_arm(w) = −(1/(n_w − 1)) · Σ_{t=2..n_w} log p_θ(x_t | x_<t)             w 为一个通用文本窗口
219	dNLL(arm) = mean_{domain} mean_{w ∈ domain} [ NLL_arm(w) − NLL_N(w) ]         主
220	PPL_degradation%(arm) = 100 · (exp(dNLL(arm)) − 1)                           展示
221	```
222	窗口前面不加任何特殊 token(不前置 `<|endoftext|>`);x_1 没有条件,不计分,t 从 2 起;n_w 为窗口实际送入模型的 id 序列长度:送入模型的是第 2.7 节用本协议分词器切分后截断得到的原始 id(最多 256 个),不解码再编码。
223	
224	**Unread controls**(问的是真实答案;不使用 NONE 选项)
225	```
226	Prior(split) = Acc(N, split, unread)
227	Spill(arm, split) = Acc(arm, split, unread) − Prior(split)                    知识外溢
228	FPR(arm, split) = (1/40) · Σ_{f ∈ unread} AllCorrect(f)                        与 FPR(N, split) 并排报告
229	```
230	E1-PILOT 不定义 NONE / 拒答任务。
231	
232	**ImmediateGain 与 Retention**
233	```
234	ImmediateGain(arm, split) = Acc(arm, split, learned) − Acc(N, split, learned)
235	Retention(arm) = [Acc_after_phase2(arm, learned_1) − Acc(N, learned_1)] / [Acc_after_phase1(arm, learned_1) − Acc(N, learned_1)]
236	                 仅当分母 ≥ 0.10 时有定义;learned_1 = 第一阶段学的 fact,phase2 = 之后在其它内容上的训练
237	```
238	E1-PILOT 只有一个训练阶段:Retention 记为 NOT_TESTED,不进任何门槛。

240	## 6. Statistical Plan
241	
242	- **Bootstrap 单位是 fact_id,不是问句。** 同一 fact 的多个问句高度相关,把问句当作独立观测会虚增样本量、使 CI 过窄(伪重复);因此先按第 5 节聚合成 Score(f),再对 fact 重抽样。
243	- 配对:比较 X 与 Y 时,`d_f = Score_X(f) − Score_Y(f)`,两个 arm 使用同一批重抽到的 fact_id。
244	- 次数 **10,000**;在 natural、random 两个 stratum 内分别有放回重抽(保持各自的 fact 数),合并后取 `Δ* = mean(d_f)`;95% CI = 第 2.5 与第 97.5 百分位。随机数:`rng_rule(BOOTSTRAP_SEED, "<比较>:<split>:<seed 或 avg>")`。
245	- **比较项**:Δ(F−N)、Δ(L−F)、Δ(A−F),在 learned fact 上;另报 Δ(S−N)、Δ(Y−N) 与各 arm 的 Spill。
246	- **报告**:每个训练种子单独报告;再报告 seed-average(先对每条 fact 把 3 个种子的 Score 取平均,再 bootstrap)。
247	- 3 个种子只作为方向一致性的证据,不作强推断。
248	- CI 是主要的不确定性描述;不报告 p 值作为判据。
249	- 精度说明:120 条 fact 时,正确率在 0.5 附近的标准误不超过 0.046。

562	## 9. Failure Taxonomy(固定集合)
563	
564	`PASS` / `HYPOTHESIS_FAIL` / `IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL` / `OPTIMIZATION_FAIL` / `CAPACITY_LIMIT` / `OPTIMIZATION_OR_CAPACITY_UNRESOLVED` / `BLOCKED` / `NOT_TESTED` / `PIPELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED`
565	
566	| 状态 | 何时使用 |
567	|---|---|
568	| PASS | 第 8 节:Gate 0 与 T1–T3 全部满足 |
569	| PIPELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED | Gate 0 或 T1–T3 任一不满足;同时给出下面的一个原因 |
570	| IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL | G0.1、G0.2、G0.6、G0.7、G0.8 不满足,或 Y 的 token 数比越界,或第 2.5 节干扰项的池少于 4 个答案,或配置冻结前读取 TEST(ST13),或实现与本协议不一致 |
571	| OPTIMIZATION_FAIL | G0.4 不满足(在给定训练量内连 TRAIN 陈述句都没有记住) |
572	| OPTIMIZATION_OR_CAPACITY_UNRESOLVED | G0.4 满足但 G0.5 或 T1 的正确率不满足 |
573	| CAPACITY_LIMIT | 仅当更强的模型在同一协议下 PASS 之后才可使用;在此之前必须保留 OPTIMIZATION_OR_CAPACITY_UNRESOLVED |
574	| HYPOTHESIS_FAIL | 保留给 E1-V1 的机制比较;E1-PILOT 没有机制假设,不使用 |
575	| BLOCKED | 环境、资源、数据来源或库版本不满足第 0 节,无法按协议执行;或第 8 步 L3–L6 任一项的 TEST 部分超限,或 L6 的 TEST 部分 Executor 与 data-auditor 的结果不一致(ST10);或任何数据、manifest、模板或候选的哈希,或模型、分词器版本与冻结值不一致(ST12) |
576	| NOT_TESTED | 未运行,或在没有违反任何条件的情况下提前停止 |
577	
578	看到结果之后不得修改任何门槛;协议本身有缺陷时,开新版本(PROTOCOL_REVISION_V2)。
579	
580	## 10. Experiment Record Template
581	
582	每次运行(含被停止的)提交一份,字段不可减:
583	
584	```
585	Experiment ID:
586	Hypothesis:
587	Purpose:
588	Independent Variable:
589	Controls:
590	Environment (CPU/GPU, commit, seed):
591	Input (data SHA, split SHA):
592	Hyperparameter budget:
593	Compute accounting (tokens / steps / FLOPs / wall-clock):
594	Expected (pre-registered):
595	Acceptance (quantified):
596	Stop Conditions:
597	Positive control result:
598	Negative control result:
599	Statistical plan:
600	Actual:
601	Status:
602	Interpretation:
603	Non-claims:
604	Next (single):
605	```
606	
607	Compute accounting 的算法:训练 FLOPs ≈ 6 · P · T,前向 FLOPs ≈ 2 · P · T(P = 参与计算的参数量,T = token 数);token、步数、wall-clock 取实测值;A 的锚文本算力单列。
608	
609	## 11. Stop Conditions
610	
611	| 编号 | 事件(可立即判断) | 动作 |
612	|---|---|---|
613	| ST1 | 第 2 步任一泄漏检查超限 | 停;不训练;IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL |
614	| ST2 | 第 3 步 N 不满足 G0.3 | 停;不训练;PIPELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED(重新校准) |
615	| ST3 | 第 4 步 F 选定配置(种子 101)的 `Acc_CB` < 0.90,或 `Acc(F, DEV-QA, learned)` < 0.70 | 阳性对照未过:停;不跑 L、A、S、Y |
616	| ST4 | Y 不满足 G0.7 | Style-only 泄漏:停;不生成 TEST |
617	| ST5 | S 不满足 G0.6 | Shuffled control 出现真实映射提升:停;不生成 TEST |
618	| ST6 | 任一次训练或评测出现非有限值 | 停该次;若发生在选定配置或对照上,IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL |
619	| ST7 | 累计 GPU wall-clock 超过 4 小时(第 7 节) | 停并报告进度;延长上限、换硬件或降级都需 Owner 决定并记录,不得静默继续 |
620	| ST8 | 环境不满足第 0 节 | BLOCKED |
621	| ST9 | 某次运行开始时读到的设备全名与首次记录不同 | 整批作废:本次 Pilot 的全部结果不得用于任何判断;BLOCKED;在设备全名一致的机器上从第 8 节第 3 步重新开始 |
622	| ST10 | 第 8 步 L3–L6 任一项的 TEST 部分超限;或 L6 的 TEST 部分 Executor 与 data-auditor 的结果不一致 | 停止;不评测 TEST;BLOCKED;报告 Owner |
623	| ST11 | 第 8 节第 2 步预检的预估总时长超过 3.5 小时 | 停止;报告 Owner |
624	| ST12 | 任何数据、manifest、模板或候选的哈希,或模型、分词器版本与冻结值不一致。比对范围:(1)`PROTOCOL_FROZEN` 中列出的数据内容哈希(fact 哈希的比对方法见第 2.2 节);(2)冻结提交下本协议文件与三个 JSON 的原始字节哈希,用 `git cat-file` 从冻结提交读取。第 8 节第 1 步写入 manifest 的实际哈希字段(`DATA_MANIFEST.json: files`、`SPLIT_MANIFEST.json: split_sha256`)不在比对范围内 | 停止;BLOCKED |
625	| ST13 | 配置冻结前读取 TEST | IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL;本次 Pilot 全部作废 |
626	
627	## 12. Out of Scope
628	
629	- E1-V1 之后的任何实验。

"""R9-2: v1.1 section 2.2 "fact 哈希的比对方法" (round 9 item 1c) applied to the facts the auditor regenerated
(r8_facts.py), plus the definition's items 3 (candidate feasibility) and 4 (fact_id split) on the same facts.
Data Auditor's own script; no Executor code is imported, called or copied. Loads the pinned Qwen tokenizer only
(four files), never weights. No question is instantiated (no DEV / TEST item, no TEST data).
Exceptions -> RESULT: FAIL (r6_guard).

a. facts.jsonl: write the 160 regenerated facts as JSONL (section 0: one canonical object per line, joined by "\n",
   one final "\n") into <out_dir>; read it back line by line in file order; canonical SHA-256 of that JSON list
   (section 0 rule) must equal the value written in the v1.1 section 2.2 method sentence, in
   DATA_MANIFEST name_generation.expected_facts_canonical_sha256 of the commit and of the v1 freeze commit.
   The JSONL canonical_sha256 (a different byte string) is printed and must differ from that value; the 2.2
   sentence says it is not compared. Each line must carry exactly the six fields of 2.2.
b. candidate feasibility: for every fact, the number of facts (including itself) with the same relation, stratum,
   exposure and the same answer token count, token count = (len(encode(" " + answer)), len(encode(answer))),
   add_special_tokens=False; also per single count. Reported per cell (relation x stratum x exposure); the minimum
   and the cells with fewer than 4 (4-way candidates need the answer plus 3 distractors) are printed.
c. split of fact_ids: 160 distinct ids; learned = E1P-L-* (120), unread = E1P-U-* (40), disjoint; per relation x
   stratum 15 learned numbered 01-15 and 5 unread numbered 01-05; exposure field agrees with the id letter;
   the auditor's rebuilt train_S.jsonl contains only learned ids (fact_id and answer_fact_id).
PASS iff a, b (minimum >= 4) and c hold.
usage: python -I r9_facts_jsonl.py <repo_root> <commit> <v1_commit> <facts.json> <train_S.jsonl> <qwen_tok_dir> <out_dir>"""
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json, re, subprocess
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from common import sha, canon, load_tok, enc
from r6_guard import run

FIELDS = ["fact_id", "exposure", "relation", "stratum", "entity", "answer"]
RELS = ["capital", "currency", "founder", "river"]
STRATA = ["natural", "random"]


def git_blob(repo, commit, path):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, "cat-file", "blob", f"{commit}:{path}"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout


def main():
    repo, commit, v1, facts_path, s_path, tokdir, out_dir = sys.argv[1:8]
    ok = True
    proto = git_blob(repo, commit, "metrix/e1-pilot/METRIX_E1_PROTOCOL.md").decode("utf-8")
    m = re.search(r"\*\*fact 哈希的比对方法\*\*:从 `facts\.jsonl` 读出 fact 列表.*?与 `([0-9a-f]{64})` 比对。", proto)
    exp_2_2 = m.group(1) if m else None
    exp_c = json.loads(git_blob(repo, commit, "metrix/e1-pilot/DATA_MANIFEST.json"))["name_generation"]["expected_facts_canonical_sha256"]
    exp_v1 = json.loads(git_blob(repo, v1, "metrix/e1-pilot/DATA_MANIFEST.json"))["name_generation"]["expected_facts_canonical_sha256"]
    print("v1.1 section 2.2 method sentence value:", exp_2_2)
    print("commit manifest value                 :", exp_c)
    print("v1 freeze-commit manifest value       :", exp_v1)
    ok &= exp_2_2 is not None and exp_2_2 == exp_c == exp_v1

    print("\n== a. facts.jsonl method (v1.1 section 2.2)")
    facts = json.load(open(facts_path, encoding="utf-8"))
    print("regenerated facts:", len(facts), "| canonical sha256 of the list as generated:", sha(canon(facts)))
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    p = os.path.join(out_dir, "facts.jsonl")
    with open(p, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(b"\n".join(canon(f) for f in facts) + b"\n")
    raw = open(p, "rb").read()
    lines = raw.decode("utf-8").split("\n")
    assert lines[-1] == "", "no final newline"
    read = [json.loads(l) for l in lines[:-1]]
    fields_ok = all(list(r.keys()) == sorted(FIELDS) and set(r) == set(FIELDS) for r in read)
    h_list = sha(canon(read))
    h_jsonl = sha(b"\n".join(canon(r) for r in read) + b"\n")
    print(f"wrote {p}: lines {len(read)} | byte_sha256 {sha(raw)}")
    print(f"every line has exactly the six fields of 2.2: {fields_ok} | order of lines = generation order: {read == facts}")
    print(f"canonical sha256 of the list read from facts.jsonl {h_list} | expected {exp_c} | MATCH {h_list == exp_c}")
    print(f"facts.jsonl canonical_sha256 by the JSONL rule (not compared per 2.2) {h_jsonl} | differs from the list hash: {h_jsonl != h_list}")
    print(f"AUDIT_VALUE facts_canonical_sha256_from_jsonl {h_list}")
    ok &= len(read) == 160 and fields_ok and read == facts and h_list == exp_c and h_jsonl != h_list

    print("\n== b. candidate feasibility (same relation, stratum, exposure, answer token count)")
    tok = load_tok(tokdir)
    print("tokenizer dir files:", sorted(x for x in os.listdir(tokdir) if not x.startswith(".")), "| class", type(tok).__name__)
    kp = {f["fact_id"]: (len(enc(tok, " " + f["answer"])), len(enc(tok, f["answer"]))) for f in facts}
    cells = defaultdict(list)
    for f in facts:
        cells[(f["relation"], f["stratum"], f["exposure"])].append(f)
    mins, short = [], []
    for rel in RELS:
        for st in STRATA:
            for ex in ("learned", "unread"):
                cf = cells[(rel, st, ex)]
                c_pair = [sum(kp[g["fact_id"]] == kp[f["fact_id"]] for g in cf) for f in cf]
                c_sp = [sum(kp[g["fact_id"]][0] == kp[f["fact_id"]][0] for g in cf) for f in cf]
                c_ns = [sum(kp[g["fact_id"]][1] == kp[f["fact_id"]][1] for g in cf) for f in cf]
                mins.append(min(c_pair))
                if min(c_pair) < 4:
                    short.append((rel, st, ex, min(c_pair)))
                print(f"  {rel:<8} {st:<7} {ex:<7} facts {len(cf):>2} | token-count pairs {dict(Counter(kp[f['fact_id']] for f in cf))} "
                      f"| candidates per fact (pair) min {min(c_pair)} max {max(c_pair)} | ' '+a only min {min(c_sp)} | a only min {min(c_ns)}")
    print(f"minimum candidates per fact over all 16 cells: {min(mins)} | cells with fewer than 4: {short}")
    ok &= min(mins) >= 4 and not short

    print("\n== c. fact_id split")
    ids = [f["fact_id"] for f in facts]
    L = [i for i in ids if i.startswith("E1P-L-")]
    U = [i for i in ids if i.startswith("E1P-U-")]
    exp_ok = all((f["exposure"] == "learned") == f["fact_id"].startswith("E1P-L-") and
                 (f["exposure"] == "unread") == f["fact_id"].startswith("E1P-U-") for f in facts)
    fmt = all(re.fullmatch(r"E1P-[LU]-(capital|currency|founder|river)-(nat|rnd)-\d\d", i) for i in ids)
    per = True
    for rel in RELS:
        for st, ab in zip(STRATA, ("nat", "rnd")):
            nl = sorted(int(i[-2:]) for i in L if f"-{rel}-{ab}-" in i)
            nu = sorted(int(i[-2:]) for i in U if f"-{rel}-{ab}-" in i)
            per &= nl == list(range(1, 16)) and nu == list(range(1, 6))
    s_rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(s_path, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()]
    s_ids = {r["fact_id"] for r in s_rows} | {r["answer_fact_id"] for r in s_rows}
    print(f"ids {len(ids)} distinct {len(set(ids))} | learned {len(L)} | unread {len(U)} | learned & unread {sorted(set(L) & set(U))} "
          f"| other prefixes {len(ids) - len(L) - len(U)}")
    print(f"id format: {fmt} | exposure field agrees with id: {exp_ok} | per cell learned 01-15 and unread 01-05: {per}")
    print(f"train_S rows {len(s_rows)} | ids in train_S {len(s_ids)} | all learned: {s_ids <= set(L)} | == learned set: {s_ids == set(L)}")
    ok &= len(set(ids)) == 160 and len(L) == 120 and len(U) == 40 and not (set(L) & set(U)) and fmt and exp_ok and per
    ok &= s_ids == set(L)
    return ok


run(main)

def generate(tok, texts):
    ablob = "\n\x00\n".join(t.lower() for t in texts)

    def draw(rng, st):
        if st == "natural":
            n = 2 if rng.random() < 0.5 else 3
            s = "".join(rng.choice(ONSETS) + rng.choice(NUCLEI) + rng.choice(CODAS) for _ in range(n))
            return s[:1].upper() + s[1:]
        u = rng.random()
        L = 3 if u < 0.25 else 4 if u < 0.75 else 5
        return "".join(rng.choice(LETTERS) for _ in range(L)) + "-" + "".join(rng.choice(DIGITS) for _ in range(2))

    def form_ok(s, st):
        if st == "natural":
            return 4 <= len(s) <= 10 and len(enc(tok, " " + s)) > 1
        return 6 <= len(s) <= 8

    def rejected(s, st, accepted):
        for a in accepted:
            if st == "natural":
                if s.lower() == a.lower() or s[:4] == a[:4] or levenshtein(s.lower(), a.lower()) <= 1:
                    return True
            else:
                if s == a or s.split("-", 1)[0] == a.split("-", 1)[0] or \
                        (len(s) == len(a) and sum(x != y for x, y in zip(s, a)) <= 1):
                    return True
        return False

    def kpair(s):
        return (len(enc(tok, " " + s)), len(enc(tok, s)))

    accepted, facts, log, anchor_rej = [], [], [], 0
    for rel in RELS:
        for st in STRATA:
            rng = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:entity")
            ents, nd = [], 0
            while len(ents) < 20:
                nd += 1
                assert nd <= CAP, "IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL entity stream"
                s = draw(rng, st)
                if form_ok(s, st) and not rejected(s, st, accepted):
                    if s.lower() in ablob:
                        anchor_rej += 1
                        continue
                    ents.append(s); accepted.append(s)
            ent_draws = nd
            rng = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:answer")
            survey, nd = Counter(), 0
            while sum(survey.values()) < 400:
                nd += 1
                assert nd <= CAP, "IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL survey"
                s = draw(rng, st)
                if form_ok(s, st):
                    survey[kpair(s)] += 1
            top = max(survey.values())
            target = min(k for k, v in survey.items() if v == top)
            rng = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:answer")       # restart the answer stream
            ans, nd = [], 0
            while len(ans) < 20:
                nd += 1
                assert nd <= CAP, "IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL answer stream"
                s = draw(rng, st)
                if form_ok(s, st) and kpair(s) == target and not rejected(s, st, accepted):
                    if s.lower() in ablob:
                        anchor_rej += 1
                        continue
                    ans.append(s); accepted.append(s)
            ab = "nat" if st == "natural" else "rnd"
            for i in range(20):
                learned = i < 15
                facts.append({"fact_id": f"E1P-{'L' if learned else 'U'}-{rel}-{ab}-{(i + 1 if learned else i - 14):02d}",
                              "exposure": "learned" if learned else "unread", "relation": rel, "stratum": st,
                              "entity": ents[i], "answer": ans[i]})
            log.append({"cell": f"{rel}/{st}", "entity_draws": ent_draws, "target_pair": list(target), "answer_draws": nd})
    return facts, log, anchor_rej


def main():
    repo, commit, tokdir, anchor_path, out_dir = sys.argv[1:6]
    ok = True
    dm = json.loads(git_blob(repo, commit, "metrix/e1-pilot/DATA_MANIFEST.json"))
    proto = git_blob(repo, commit, "metrix/e1-pilot/METRIX_E1_PROTOCOL.md").decode("utf-8")
    ng = dm["name_generation"]
    exp = ng["expected_facts_canonical_sha256"]
    m22 = re.search(r"规范化 SHA-256 必须等于 `([0-9a-f]{64})`。参考实现 `reports/round2/names.py`", proto)
    print("freeze-commit manifest expected_facts_canonical_sha256:", exp)

    ok &= bool(m22) and m22.group(1) == exp
    checks = [

        ("facts.strata", dm["facts"]["strata"], STRATA),
        ("natural.onsets", ng["natural"]["onsets"], ONSETS),
        ("natural.nuclei", ng["natural"]["nuclei"], NUCLEI),
        ("natural.codas", ng["natural"]["codas"], CODAS),
        ("natural.length_chars", ng["natural"]["length_chars"], [4, 10]),
        ("random.letters", ng["random"]["letters"], LETTERS),

        ("streams.entity", ng["streams"]["entity"], "rng_rule(DATA_SEED, 'names:<relation>:<stratum>:entity')"),
        ("streams.answer", ng["streams"]["answer"], "rng_rule(DATA_SEED, 'names:<relation>:<stratum>:answer')"),

    for name, got, want in checks:
        print(f"  manifest {name} == transcribed: {got == want}")

    texts = json.load(open(anchor_path, encoding="utf-8"))
    ah = sha(canon(texts))
    print("anchor texts:", len(texts), "| canonical sha256", ah, "| == manifest anchor_text.decoded_texts_canonical_sha256:",
          ah == dm["anchor_text"]["decoded_texts_canonical_sha256"])
    ok &= ah == dm["anchor_text"]["decoded_texts_canonical_sha256"]
    tok = load_tok(tokdir)
    print("tokenizer dir files:", sorted(x for x in os.listdir(tokdir) if not x.startswith(".")))
    facts, log, anchor_rej = generate(tok, texts)
    for c in log:
        print("  cell", json.dumps(c))
    print("anchor-rule rejections:", anchor_rej)
    strings = [x for f in facts for x in (f["entity"], f["answer"])]
    print("facts", len(facts), dict(Counter(f["exposure"] for f in facts)), "| distinct strings", len(set(strings)))
    ok &= len(facts) == 160 and len(set(strings)) == 320
    h = sha(canon(facts))
    print(f"regenerated facts canonical sha256 {h} | manifest {exp} | MATCH {h == exp}")
    print(f"AUDIT_VALUE facts_canonical_sha256 {h}")
    ok &= h == exp
    print("first fact:", json.dumps(facts[0], ensure_ascii=False), "| last fact:", json.dumps(facts[-1], ensure_ascii=False))
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "facts.json"), "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(canon(facts))
    print("wrote", os.path.join(out_dir, "facts.json"))
    return ok

"""Data Auditor helpers (independent; no Executor code)."""
import hashlib, json, random

FACTS_SHA_PROTOCOL = "406c8801c5b69ed235cbe516658ad9ee3e3a8cfe8e4e348a0c1fd7952f2e6b97"
RELATIONS = ["capital", "currency", "founder", "river"]
STRATA = ["natural", "random"]
TRAIN_T = {"capital": "The capital of {E} is {A}.",
           "currency": "The currency used in {E} is the {A}.",
           "founder": "{E} was founded by {A}.",
           "river": "The river that flows through {E} is the {A}."}


def canon(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


def rng_rule(seed, purpose):
    return random.Random(int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f"{seed}:{purpose}".encode("utf-8")).digest()[:8], "big"))


def load_tok(d):
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    return AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(d, local_files_only=True)


def enc(tok, s):
    return tok.encode(s, add_special_tokens=False)

"""Data Auditor helper (round 6, item 2 rule applied to the auditor's own new scripts). Independent; no Executor code.

run(main): main() returns True (checks passed) or False (a check failed).
  - True  -> prints "RESULT: PASS", exit code 0
  - False -> prints "RESULT: FAIL", exit code 1
  - any exception, including SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt raised inside main() -> traceback on stdout,
    "RESULT: FAIL", exit code 2
  - main() returning anything other than True / False -> "RESULT: FAIL", exit code 3
Scripts using this helper never call sys.exit themselves."""
import sys
import traceback


def run(main):
    try:
        ok = main()
    except BaseException:                      # noqa: B902 - deliberate: every failure path ends in RESULT: FAIL
        sys.stdout.flush()
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stdout)
        print("RESULT: FAIL (exception)")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        sys.exit(2)
    if ok is True:
        print("RESULT: PASS")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        sys.exit(0)
    if ok is False:

# Claude Code agent proxy

Outbound HTTPS from this session goes through a local proxy at http://127.0.0.1:43749
(set via HTTPS_PROXY) which tunnels to a policy-enforcing egress proxy. TLS is
re-terminated there, so every tool must trust the CA bundle at
/root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt. The standard CA environment variables, the system trust
store (where possible), a JVM truststore, the Bazel system bazelrc, the
browser NSS store, and gsutil's boto config are already set up.

## Quick diagnosis

1. Read the end of the failed command's output. When the proxy refused or lost
   a connection while a Bash command ran, Claude Code adds [agent-proxy] lines
   there with the host and the reason. A command that ran in the background,
   or whose exit status hides the failure (piped into another command, or
   followed by "|| true"), gets none.
2. Find the failure class below and apply the matching fix.
3. Never disable TLS verification, never unset HTTPS_PROXY, and do not retry
   policy denials (403/407) — report them instead.

## Failure classes and fixes

### "certificate verify failed" / "self-signed certificate in chain" / PKIX errors

The failing tool is not reading the pre-set CA configuration. In order:

- If the tool has a CA flag or env var, point it at /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt
  (examples: --cacert, SSL_CERT_FILE, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE,
  AWS_CA_BUNDLE, DENO_CERT, CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO, PIP_CERT, GIT_SSL_CAINFO,
  BUNDLE_SSL_CA_CERT, HEX_CACERTS_PATH, NIX_SSL_CERT_FILE).
- Tool config files override environment variables. If one of these sets its
  own CA or disables verification, point it at the bundle instead:
  pip.conf "cert", npm "cafile" (npm config get cafile), ~/.curlrc "cacert",
  .wgetrc "ca_certificate", conda "ssl_verify", git "http.sslCAInfo",
  gradle.properties / MAVEN_OPTS "-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore".
- JVM tools (Maven, Gradle, plain Java): when a JDK is present,
  JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS points JVMs at a truststore that holds the proxy CA: the
  JDK's own store if the system trust install already added the CA there,
  otherwise /root/.ccr/java-truststore.p12 (password "changeit"). Confirm
  that JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS sets a trustStore before pointing a build at either:
  where it sets none, set-up was skipped, has not finished or has failed. If
  the image or the build sets its own trustStore, that one wins — import the
  proxy CA into it with
  keytool -importcert -noprompt -alias ccr-agent-proxy -file /root/.ccr/agent-proxy-ca.crt -keystore <their store>
  or point the build at the ready-made one. Bazel reads the managed block in
  /etc/bazel.bazelrc rather than JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS.

### "405 Method Not Allowed" from the proxy

The tool sent a plain-HTTP (non-CONNECT) request: usually axios older than
1.16.1 (upgrade it) or a tool configured with HTTP_PROXY (unset HTTP_PROXY for
that tool — only HTTPS_PROXY is supported).

### 403 / 407 from the proxy

Most often the destination host is not allowed for this session. Do not retry
or route around it — report the blocked host.
Note: curl hides response bodies on failed CONNECTs; the [agent-proxy] lines
give the host and, where the egress proxy answered one, the HTTP status.

### 429 / 503 from the proxy

Too many connections or requests went through the proxy, or the egress proxy
was busy. The proxy can hold a connection for about a minute before it refuses
it, so a tool with a short timeout of its own may report only a timeout. Run
fewer downloads or requests at once, then retry.

The proxy also answers 429 immediately when too many connections to it are open,
idle ones included (too_many_connections in the [agent-proxy] lines under a
failed command). Look for a program that opens connections and never closes
them. New connections work again once some have closed.

### 408 from the proxy

The tool opened a connection to the proxy and sent no complete request within 30
seconds, so the proxy closed it. Retry once. If it happens again, the tool opens
connections before it has a request to send, it is paused or short of CPU, or its
request never ends with an empty line in CRLF form (bare LF line ends, or another
protocol such as SOCKS).

"""PILOT_REPORT_ORDER item 3, part 1: the fact order of facts.jsonl (needed by interpretation B10).

Data Auditor's own script, written new for this task. It does not import, call or copy any Executor code
(metrix/e1-pilot/src/, run_pilot.py, tests/, reports/round*/). CPU only. It loads the tokenizer.json of
Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B@70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e with the `tokenizers` library (no model weights,
no transformers, no torch). It does not read, generate or look for any TEST file; it instantiates no question.

facts.jsonl itself was not committed (it lived in <work>/data of the terminated machine). This script
  1. regenerates the 160 facts from the rules of protocol 2.2 (DATA_SEED 20261110), WITHOUT the anchor rule
     (the anchor texts would need the 94 MB parquet; see the note printed below);
  2. checks the canonical SHA-256 of the regenerated list against the frozen fact hash (protocol 2.2 text,
     DATA_MANIFEST name_generation.expected_facts_canonical_sha256, results/step1_record.json content_hashes.facts);
  3. writes the list as facts.jsonl bytes (protocol 0: one canonical object per line, joined by "\\n", one final
     "\\n") in memory and compares the SHA-256 of these bytes with the facts.jsonl byte_sha256 / canonical_sha256
     recorded by the formal run (results/step1_record.json environment.data_hashes["facts.jsonl"]) and with
     DATA_MANIFEST.json files["facts.jsonl"]. Equality of the byte hash proves that the line order used here IS
     the line order of the facts.jsonl of the formal run;
  4. cross-checks the regenerated answers with the answers in the committed DEV details
     (results/details/N_dev.json: candidates[answer_index] of every dev_qa and train_cb row), and rebuilds
     candidates.json (protocol 2.5 detail 5) and compares it with the frozen candidate hash and with the
     candidate lists in the committed DEV details;
  5. writes the fact order (fact_id, exposure, relation, stratum only; no entity / answer strings) to <out_json>
     for pilot_final_recompute.py.
PASS iff every check holds.
usage: <python with tokenizers> -I pilot_final_facts_order.py <repo_root> <qwen tokenizer.json> <out_json>"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import random
import re
import socket
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

# ---- protocol 2.2 constants, transcribed from METRIX_E1_PROTOCOL.md (cross-checked with DATA_MANIFEST below)
DATA_SEED = 20261110
CANDIDATE_SEED = 20261111
RELS = ["capital", "currency", "founder", "river"]
STRATA = ["natural", "random"]
ONSETS = "b d f g k l m n p r s t v z br dr kr tr sh th".split()
NUCLEI = "a e i o u ae ia ou".split()
CODAS = ["", "", "n", "r", "l", "s", "th", "nd"]
LETTERS = "BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ"
DIGITS = "23456789"
CAP = 20000
FIELDS = ["fact_id", "exposure", "relation", "stratum", "entity", "answer"]


def canon(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


def rng_rule(seed, purpose):
    return random.Random(int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f"{seed}:{purpose}".encode("utf-8")).digest()[:8], "big"))


def edit_distance(a, b):
    prev = list(range(len(b) + 1))
    for i, ca in enumerate(a, 1):
        cur = [i]
        for j, cb in enumerate(b, 1):
            cur.append(min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + (ca != cb)))
        prev = cur
    return prev[-1]


def regenerate(encode):
    def draw(r, st):
        if st == "natural":
            n = 2 if r.random() < 0.5 else 3
            s = "".join(r.choice(ONSETS) + r.choice(NUCLEI) + r.choice(CODAS) for _ in range(n))
            return s[:1].upper() + s[1:]
        u = r.random()
        n = 3 if u < 0.25 else 4 if u < 0.75 else 5
        return "".join(r.choice(LETTERS) for _ in range(n)) + "-" + "".join(r.choice(DIGITS) for _ in range(2))

    def form_ok(s, st):
        if st == "natural":
            return 4 <= len(s) <= 10 and len(encode(" " + s)) > 1
        return 6 <= len(s) <= 8

    def letter_part(s):
        return s.split("-", 1)[0]

    def conflicts(s, st, accepted):
        for a in accepted:
            if st == "natural":
                if s.lower() == a.lower() or s[:4] == a[:4] or edit_distance(s.lower(), a.lower()) <= 1:
                    return True
            else:
                if s == a or letter_part(s) == letter_part(a):
                    return True
                if len(s) == len(a) and sum(x != y for x, y in zip(s, a)) <= 1:
                    return True
        return False

    def kpair(s):
        return (len(encode(" " + s)), len(encode(s)))

    accepted, facts, log = [], [], []
    for rel in RELS:
        for st in STRATA:
            r = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:entity")
            ents, nd = [], 0
            while len(ents) < 20:
                nd += 1
                if nd > CAP:
                    raise RuntimeError("entity stream exhausted")
                s = draw(r, st)
                if form_ok(s, st) and not conflicts(s, st, accepted):
                    ents.append(s)
                    accepted.append(s)
            ent_draws = nd
            r = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:answer")
            survey, nd = Counter(), 0
            while sum(survey.values()) < 400:
                nd += 1
                if nd > CAP:
                    raise RuntimeError("survey exhausted")
                s = draw(r, st)
                if form_ok(s, st):
                    survey[kpair(s)] += 1
            top = max(survey.values())
            target = min(k for k, v in survey.items() if v == top)
            r = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:answer")   # restart the answer stream (detail 3)
            ans, nd = [], 0
            while len(ans) < 20:
                nd += 1
                if nd > CAP:
                    raise RuntimeError("answer stream exhausted")
                s = draw(r, st)
                if form_ok(s, st) and kpair(s) == target and not conflicts(s, st, accepted):
                    ans.append(s)
                    accepted.append(s)
            ab = "nat" if st == "natural" else "rnd"
            for i in range(20):
                lrn = i < 15
                facts.append({"fact_id": f"E1P-{'L' if lrn else 'U'}-{rel}-{ab}-{(i + 1) if lrn else (i - 14):02d}",
                              "exposure": "learned" if lrn else "unread", "relation": rel, "stratum": st,
                              "entity": ents[i], "answer": ans[i]})
            log.append((f"{rel}/{st}", ent_draws, target, nd))
    return facts, log


def main():
    repo, tok_path, out_json = sys.argv[1:4]
    e1 = os.path.join(repo, "metrix", "e1-pilot")
    ok = True
    print(f"host {socket.gethostname()} | {platform.platform()} | python {sys.version.split()[0]} | CPU only")
    import tokenizers
    print(f"tokenizers {tokenizers.__version__} (tokenizer.json only; no transformers, no torch, no weights)")
    dm = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "DATA_MANIFEST.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    proto = open(os.path.join(e1, "METRIX_E1_PROTOCOL.md"), encoding="utf-8").read()
    step1 = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "results", "step1_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    sfr = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "results", "selection_freeze_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    spm = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "SPLIT_MANIFEST.json"), encoding="utf-8"))

    print("\n== 0. tokenizer file")
    tb = open(tok_path, "rb").read()
    want = dm["model"]["tokenizer"]["files_sha256"]["tokenizer.json"]
    print(f"tokenizer.json bytes {len(tb)} sha256 {sha(tb)} | DATA_MANIFEST model.tokenizer.files_sha256 {want} | MATCH {sha(tb) == want}")
    print(f"DATA_MANIFEST model.tokenizer repo/revision: {dm['model']['tokenizer']['repo']}@{dm['model']['tokenizer']['revision']}")
    ok &= sha(tb) == want
    tk = tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file(tok_path)

    def encode(s):
        return tk.encode(s, add_special_tokens=False).ids

    print("\n== 1. constants transcribed from protocol 2.2 vs DATA_MANIFEST")
    ng = dm["name_generation"]
    checks = [("seeds.DATA_SEED", dm["seeds"]["DATA_SEED"], DATA_SEED),
              ("seeds.CANDIDATE_SEED", dm["seeds"]["CANDIDATE_SEED"], CANDIDATE_SEED),
              ("facts.relations", dm["facts"]["relations"], RELS), ("facts.strata", dm["facts"]["strata"], STRATA),
              ("name_generation.natural.onsets", ng["natural"]["onsets"], ONSETS),
              ("name_generation.natural.nuclei", ng["natural"]["nuclei"], NUCLEI),
              ("name_generation.natural.codas", ng["natural"]["codas"], CODAS),
              ("name_generation.random.letters", ng["random"]["letters"], LETTERS),
              ("name_generation.random.digits", ng["random"]["digits"], DIGITS),
              ("name_generation.max_draws_per_stream", ng["max_draws_per_stream"], CAP),
              ("name_generation.expected_facts_fields", ng["expected_facts_fields"], FIELDS)]
    for name, got, exp in checks:
        print(f"  {name}: manifest == transcribed {got == exp}")
        ok &= got == exp
    print(f"  name_generation.order: {ng['order']}")

    print("\n== 2. regeneration (protocol 2.2, anchor rule NOT applied)")
    print("note: the anchor rule (reject strings occurring in the 512 anchor texts) is not applied because the anchor")
    print("      texts are not available on this host without downloading the parquet. This cannot make a wrong list")
    print("      pass: the result is accepted only if its canonical hash equals the frozen fact hash below. My own")
    print("      round-9 regeneration WITH the anchor rule recorded 'anchor-rule rejections: 0'")
    print("      (metrix/e1-pilot/audit/stdout/87a244db28a901f9e89282b50df76778ab5c2887/04_r8_facts.txt).")
    facts, log = regenerate(encode)
    for cell, ed, tgt, adr in log:
        print(f"  cell {cell:<17} entity draws {ed:>3} | target (K_st, K_qa) {tgt} | answer draws {adr:>3}")
    strings = [x for f in facts for x in (f["entity"], f["answer"])]
    print(f"facts {len(facts)} {dict(Counter(f['exposure'] for f in facts))} | distinct strings {len(set(strings))}")
    ok &= len(facts) == 160 and len(set(strings)) == 320

    print("\n== 3. canonical hash of the fact list (protocol 2.2 method)")
    m = re.search(r"\*\*复现\*\*:按以上规则,`DATA_SEED = 20261110` 生成的 160 条 fact.*?必须等于 `([0-9a-f]{64})`", proto)
    h_list = sha(canon(facts))
    refs = {"protocol 2.2 '复现' sentence": m.group(1) if m else None,
            "DATA_MANIFEST name_generation.expected_facts_canonical_sha256": ng["expected_facts_canonical_sha256"],
            "results/step1_record.json content_hashes.facts": step1["content_hashes"]["facts"],
            "results/selection_freeze_record.json data_content_hashes.facts": sfr["data_content_hashes"]["facts"]}
    print(f"regenerated list canonical sha256: {h_list}")
    for k, v in refs.items():
        print(f"  {k}: {v} | MATCH {v == h_list}")
        ok &= v == h_list

    print("\n== 4. facts.jsonl bytes (protocol 0 JSONL rule) vs the byte hash recorded by the formal run")
    jsonl = b"\n".join(canon(f) for f in facts) + b"\n"
    h_bytes = sha(jsonl)
    rec = step1["environment"]["data_hashes"]["facts.jsonl"]
    man = dm["files"]["facts.jsonl"]
    print(f"facts.jsonl rebuilt in memory: {len(jsonl)} bytes, {jsonl.count(b'{chr(10)}'.replace(b'{chr(10)}', b'\\n'))} lines, sha256 {h_bytes}")
    for k, v in [("results/step1_record.json environment.data_hashes['facts.jsonl'].byte_sha256", rec["byte_sha256"]),
                 ("results/step1_record.json environment.data_hashes['facts.jsonl'].canonical_sha256", rec["canonical_sha256"]),
                 ("DATA_MANIFEST.json files['facts.jsonl'].byte_sha256", man["byte_sha256"]),
                 ("DATA_MANIFEST.json files['facts.jsonl'].canonical_sha256", man["canonical_sha256"])]:
        print(f"  {k}: {v} | MATCH {v == h_bytes}")
        ok &= v == h_bytes
    print(f"results/step1_record.json data_generation.rows['facts.jsonl']: {step1['data_generation']['rows']['facts.jsonl']}")
    ok &= step1["data_generation"]["rows"]["facts.jsonl"] == 160
    # reading the lines back in file order gives the same list (the line order is the list order)
    back = [json.loads(x) for x in jsonl.decode("utf-8").split("\n")[:-1]]
    print(f"lines read back in file order == regenerated list: {back == facts} | every line has exactly the six 2.2 fields: "
          f"{all(set(x) == set(FIELDS) for x in back)}")
    ok &= back == facts and all(set(x) == set(FIELDS) for x in back)

    print("\n== 5. cross-check with committed DEV details (results/details/N_dev.json)")
    nd = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "results", "details", "N_dev.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    ans = {f["fact_id"]: f["answer"] for f in facts}
    det_ans, det_cands, bad = defaultdict(set), defaultdict(set), []
    for part in ("dev_qa", "train_cb"):
        for row in nd["evaluation"][part]:
            det_ans[row["fact_id"]].add(row["candidates"][row["answer_index"]])
            det_cands[row["fact_id"]].add(tuple(row["candidates"]))
    for fid, a in ans.items():
        if det_ans.get(fid) != {a}:
            bad.append(fid)
    print(f"fact_ids in details {len(det_ans)} | == regenerated ids {set(det_ans) == set(ans)} | facts whose details answer "
          f"!= regenerated answer: {bad}")
    ok &= set(det_ans) == set(ans) and not bad
    # candidates.json, protocol 2.5 detail 5
    cands = {}
    for f in facts:
        pool = [g["answer"] for g in facts if g["relation"] == f["relation"] and g["stratum"] == f["stratum"]
                and g["exposure"] == f["exposure"] and g["fact_id"] != f["fact_id"]]
        r = rng_rule(CANDIDATE_SEED, f"cand:{f['fact_id']}")
        d = r.sample(pool, 3)
        c = [f["answer"]] + d
        r.shuffle(c)
        cands[f["fact_id"]] = c
    hc = sha(canon(cands))
    for k, v in [("SPLIT_MANIFEST candidates.candidate_mapping_sha256", spm["candidates"]["candidate_mapping_sha256"]),
                 ("results/step1_record.json content_hashes.candidates", step1["content_hashes"]["candidates"])]:
        print(f"rebuilt candidates.json canonical sha256 {hc} | {k} {v} | MATCH {hc == v}")
        ok &= hc == v
    cbad = [fid for fid in cands if det_cands.get(fid) != {tuple(cands[fid])}]
    print(f"facts whose candidate list in N_dev.json differs from the rebuilt one: {cbad}")
    ok &= not cbad

    print("\n== 6. fact order")
    rule = []
    for rel in RELS:
        for ab in ("nat", "rnd"):
            rule += [f"E1P-L-{rel}-{ab}-{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 16)] + [f"E1P-U-{rel}-{ab}-{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 6)]
    order = [f["fact_id"] for f in facts]
    print(f"order of facts.jsonl (confirmed by the byte hash above) == protocol 2.2 generation-order rule "
          f"(cells capital..river x natural, random; per cell L-01..15 then U-01..05): {order == rule}")
    ok &= order == rule
    id_ok = all((f["exposure"] == "learned") == f["fact_id"].startswith("E1P-L-") and
                (f["stratum"] == "natural") == (f["fact_id"].split("-")[3] == "nat") and

"""PILOT_REPORT_ORDER item 3, part 1: the fact order of facts.jsonl (needed by interpretation B10).

Data Auditor's own script, written new for this task. It does not import, call or copy any Executor code
(metrix/e1-pilot/src/, run_pilot.py, tests/, reports/round*/). CPU only. It loads the tokenizer.json of
Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B@70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e with the `tokenizers` library (no model weights,
no transformers, no torch). It does not read, generate or look for any TEST file; it instantiates no question.

facts.jsonl itself was not committed (it lived in <work>/data of the terminated machine). This script
  1. regenerates the 160 facts from the rules of protocol 2.2 (DATA_SEED 20261110), WITHOUT the anchor rule
     (the anchor texts would need the 94 MB parquet; see the note printed below);
  2. checks the canonical SHA-256 of the regenerated list against the frozen fact hash (protocol 2.2 text,
     DATA_MANIFEST name_generation.expected_facts_canonical_sha256, results/step1_record.json content_hashes.facts);
  3. writes the list as facts.jsonl bytes (protocol 0: one canonical object per line, joined by "\\n", one final
     "\\n") in memory and compares the SHA-256 of these bytes with the facts.jsonl byte_sha256 / canonical_sha256
     recorded by the formal run (results/step1_record.json environment.data_hashes["facts.jsonl"]) and with
     DATA_MANIFEST.json files["facts.jsonl"]. Equality of the byte hash proves that the line order used here IS
     the line order of the facts.jsonl of the formal run;
  4. cross-checks the regenerated answers with the answers in the committed DEV details
     (results/details/N_dev.json: candidates[answer_index] of every dev_qa and train_cb row), and rebuilds
     candidates.json (protocol 2.5 detail 5) and compares it with the frozen candidate hash and with the
     candidate lists in the committed DEV details;
  5. writes the fact order (fact_id, exposure, relation, stratum only; no entity / answer strings) to <out_json>
     for pilot_final_recompute.py.
PASS iff every check holds.
usage: <python with tokenizers> -I pilot_final_facts_order.py <repo_root> <qwen tokenizer.json> <out_json>"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import random
import re
import socket
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

# ---- protocol 2.2 constants, transcribed from METRIX_E1_PROTOCOL.md (cross-checked with DATA_MANIFEST below)
DATA_SEED = 20261110
CANDIDATE_SEED = 20261111
RELS = ["capital", "currency", "founder", "river"]
STRATA = ["natural", "random"]
ONSETS = "b d f g k l m n p r s t v z br dr kr tr sh th".split()
NUCLEI = "a e i o u ae ia ou".split()
CODAS = ["", "", "n", "r", "l", "s", "th", "nd"]
LETTERS = "BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ"
DIGITS = "23456789"
CAP = 20000
FIELDS = ["fact_id", "exposure", "relation", "stratum", "entity", "answer"]


def canon(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


def rng_rule(seed, purpose):
    return random.Random(int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f"{seed}:{purpose}".encode("utf-8")).digest()[:8], "big"))


def edit_distance(a, b):
    prev = list(range(len(b) + 1))
    for i, ca in enumerate(a, 1):
        cur = [i]
        for j, cb in enumerate(b, 1):
            cur.append(min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + (ca != cb)))
        prev = cur
    return prev[-1]


def regenerate(encode):
    def draw(r, st):
        if st == "natural":
            n = 2 if r.random() < 0.5 else 3
            s = "".join(r.choice(ONSETS) + r.choice(NUCLEI) + r.choice(CODAS) for _ in range(n))
            return s[:1].upper() + s[1:]
        u = r.random()
        n = 3 if u < 0.25 else 4 if u < 0.75 else 5
        return "".join(r.choice(LETTERS) for _ in range(n)) + "-" + "".join(r.choice(DIGITS) for _ in range(2))

    def form_ok(s, st):
        if st == "natural":
            return 4 <= len(s) <= 10 and len(encode(" " + s)) > 1
        return 6 <= len(s) <= 8

    def letter_part(s):
        return s.split("-", 1)[0]

    def conflicts(s, st, accepted):
        for a in accepted:
            if st == "natural":
                if s.lower() == a.lower() or s[:4] == a[:4] or edit_distance(s.lower(), a.lower()) <= 1:
                    return True
            else:
                if s == a or letter_part(s) == letter_part(a):
                    return True
                if len(s) == len(a) and sum(x != y for x, y in zip(s, a)) <= 1:
                    return True
        return False

    def kpair(s):
        return (len(encode(" " + s)), len(encode(s)))

    accepted, facts, log = [], [], []
    for rel in RELS:
        for st in STRATA:
            r = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:entity")
            ents, nd = [], 0
            while len(ents) < 20:
                nd += 1
                if nd > CAP:
                    raise RuntimeError("entity stream exhausted")
                s = draw(r, st)
                if form_ok(s, st) and not conflicts(s, st, accepted):
                    ents.append(s)
                    accepted.append(s)
            ent_draws = nd
            r = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:answer")
            survey, nd = Counter(), 0
            while sum(survey.values()) < 400:
                nd += 1
                if nd > CAP:
                    raise RuntimeError("survey exhausted")
                s = draw(r, st)
                if form_ok(s, st):
                    survey[kpair(s)] += 1
            top = max(survey.values())
            target = min(k for k, v in survey.items() if v == top)
            r = rng_rule(DATA_SEED, f"names:{rel}:{st}:answer")   # restart the answer stream (detail 3)
            ans, nd = [], 0
            while len(ans) < 20:
                nd += 1
                if nd > CAP:
                    raise RuntimeError("answer stream exhausted")
                s = draw(r, st)
                if form_ok(s, st) and kpair(s) == target and not conflicts(s, st, accepted):
                    ans.append(s)
                    accepted.append(s)
            ab = "nat" if st == "natural" else "rnd"
            for i in range(20):
                lrn = i < 15
                facts.append({"fact_id": f"E1P-{'L' if lrn else 'U'}-{rel}-{ab}-{(i + 1) if lrn else (i - 14):02d}",
                              "exposure": "learned" if lrn else "unread", "relation": rel, "stratum": st,
                              "entity": ents[i], "answer": ans[i]})
            log.append((f"{rel}/{st}", ent_draws, target, nd))
    return facts, log


def main():
    repo, tok_path, out_json = sys.argv[1:4]
    e1 = os.path.join(repo, "metrix", "e1-pilot")
    ok = True
    print(f"host {socket.gethostname()} | {platform.platform()} | python {sys.version.split()[0]} | CPU only")
    import tokenizers
    print(f"tokenizers {tokenizers.__version__} (tokenizer.json only; no transformers, no torch, no weights)")
    dm = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "DATA_MANIFEST.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    proto = open(os.path.join(e1, "METRIX_E1_PROTOCOL.md"), encoding="utf-8").read()
    step1 = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "results", "step1_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    sfr = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "results", "selection_freeze_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    spm = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "SPLIT_MANIFEST.json"), encoding="utf-8"))

    print("\n== 0. tokenizer file")
    tb = open(tok_path, "rb").read()
    want = dm["model"]["tokenizer"]["files_sha256"]["tokenizer.json"]
    print(f"tokenizer.json bytes {len(tb)} sha256 {sha(tb)} | DATA_MANIFEST model.tokenizer.files_sha256 {want} | MATCH {sha(tb) == want}")
    print(f"DATA_MANIFEST model.tokenizer repo/revision: {dm['model']['tokenizer']['repo']}@{dm['model']['tokenizer']['revision']}")
    ok &= sha(tb) == want
    tk = tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file(tok_path)

    def encode(s):
        return tk.encode(s, add_special_tokens=False).ids

    print("\n== 1. constants transcribed from protocol 2.2 vs DATA_MANIFEST")
    ng = dm["name_generation"]
    checks = [("seeds.DATA_SEED", dm["seeds"]["DATA_SEED"], DATA_SEED),
              ("seeds.CANDIDATE_SEED", dm["seeds"]["CANDIDATE_SEED"], CANDIDATE_SEED),
              ("facts.relations", dm["facts"]["relations"], RELS), ("facts.strata", dm["facts"]["strata"], STRATA),
              ("name_generation.natural.onsets", ng["natural"]["onsets"], ONSETS),
              ("name_generation.natural.nuclei", ng["natural"]["nuclei"], NUCLEI),
              ("name_generation.natural.codas", ng["natural"]["codas"], CODAS),
              ("name_generation.random.letters", ng["random"]["letters"], LETTERS),
              ("name_generation.random.digits", ng["random"]["digits"], DIGITS),
              ("name_generation.max_draws_per_stream", ng["max_draws_per_stream"], CAP),
              ("name_generation.expected_facts_fields", ng["expected_facts_fields"], FIELDS)]
    for name, got, exp in checks:
        print(f"  {name}: manifest == transcribed {got == exp}")
        ok &= got == exp
    print(f"  name_generation.order: {ng['order']}")

    print("\n== 2. regeneration (protocol 2.2, anchor rule NOT applied)")
    print("note: the anchor rule (reject strings occurring in the 512 anchor texts) is not applied because the anchor")
    print("      texts are not available on this host without downloading the parquet. This cannot make a wrong list")
    print("      pass: the result is accepted only if its canonical hash equals the frozen fact hash below. My own")
    print("      round-9 regeneration WITH the anchor rule recorded 'anchor-rule rejections: 0'")
    print("      (metrix/e1-pilot/audit/stdout/87a244db28a901f9e89282b50df76778ab5c2887/04_r8_facts.txt).")
    facts, log = regenerate(encode)
    for cell, ed, tgt, adr in log:
        print(f"  cell {cell:<17} entity draws {ed:>3} | target (K_st, K_qa) {tgt} | answer draws {adr:>3}")
    strings = [x for f in facts for x in (f["entity"], f["answer"])]
    print(f"facts {len(facts)} {dict(Counter(f['exposure'] for f in facts))} | distinct strings {len(set(strings))}")
    ok &= len(facts) == 160 and len(set(strings)) == 320

    print("\n== 3. canonical hash of the fact list (protocol 2.2 method)")
    m = re.search(r"\*\*复现\*\*:按以上规则,`DATA_SEED = 20261110` 生成的 160 条 fact.*?必须等于 `([0-9a-f]{64})`", proto)
    h_list = sha(canon(facts))
    refs = {"protocol 2.2 '复现' sentence": m.group(1) if m else None,
            "DATA_MANIFEST name_generation.expected_facts_canonical_sha256": ng["expected_facts_canonical_sha256"],
            "results/step1_record.json content_hashes.facts": step1["content_hashes"]["facts"],
            "results/selection_freeze_record.json data_content_hashes.facts": sfr["data_content_hashes"]["facts"]}
    print(f"regenerated list canonical sha256: {h_list}")
    for k, v in refs.items():
        print(f"  {k}: {v} | MATCH {v == h_list}")
        ok &= v == h_list

    print("\n== 4. facts.jsonl bytes (protocol 0 JSONL rule) vs the byte hash recorded by the formal run")
    jsonl = b"\n".join(canon(f) for f in facts) + b"\n"
    h_bytes = sha(jsonl)
    rec = step1["environment"]["data_hashes"]["facts.jsonl"]
    man = dm["files"]["facts.jsonl"]
    print(f"facts.jsonl rebuilt in memory: {len(jsonl)} bytes, {jsonl.count(b'{chr(10)}'.replace(b'{chr(10)}', b'\\n'))} lines, sha256 {h_bytes}")
    for k, v in [("results/step1_record.json environment.data_hashes['facts.jsonl'].byte_sha256", rec["byte_sha256"]),
                 ("results/step1_record.json environment.data_hashes['facts.jsonl'].canonical_sha256", rec["canonical_sha256"]),
                 ("DATA_MANIFEST.json files['facts.jsonl'].byte_sha256", man["byte_sha256"]),
                 ("DATA_MANIFEST.json files['facts.jsonl'].canonical_sha256", man["canonical_sha256"])]:
        print(f"  {k}: {v} | MATCH {v == h_bytes}")
        ok &= v == h_bytes
    print(f"results/step1_record.json data_generation.rows['facts.jsonl']: {step1['data_generation']['rows']['facts.jsonl']}")
    ok &= step1["data_generation"]["rows"]["facts.jsonl"] == 160
    # reading the lines back in file order gives the same list (the line order is the list order)
    back = [json.loads(x) for x in jsonl.decode("utf-8").split("\n")[:-1]]
    print(f"lines read back in file order == regenerated list: {back == facts} | every line has exactly the six 2.2 fields: "
          f"{all(set(x) == set(FIELDS) for x in back)}")
    ok &= back == facts and all(set(x) == set(FIELDS) for x in back)

    print("\n== 5. cross-check with committed DEV details (results/details/N_dev.json)")
    nd = json.load(open(os.path.join(e1, "results", "details", "N_dev.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    ans = {f["fact_id"]: f["answer"] for f in facts}
    det_ans, det_cands, bad = defaultdict(set), defaultdict(set), []
    for part in ("dev_qa", "train_cb"):
        for row in nd["evaluation"][part]:
            det_ans[row["fact_id"]].add(row["candidates"][row["answer_index"]])
            det_cands[row["fact_id"]].add(tuple(row["candidates"]))
    for fid, a in ans.items():
        if det_ans.get(fid) != {a}:
            bad.append(fid)
    print(f"fact_ids in details {len(det_ans)} | == regenerated ids {set(det_ans) == set(ans)} | facts whose details answer "
          f"!= regenerated answer: {bad}")
    ok &= set(det_ans) == set(ans) and not bad

    rule = []
    for rel in RELS:

            rule += [f"E1P-L-{rel}-{ab}-{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 16)] + [f"E1P-U-{rel}-{ab}-{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 6)]

            print(f"  {ex:<7} {st:<7}: {len(ids):>3} facts, in facts.jsonl order first {ids[:2]} ... last {ids[-1]}")
    out = {"what": "fact order of facts.jsonl of the formal run (B10), regenerated by pilot_final_facts_order.py",
           "confirmation": {"facts_jsonl_sha256_rebuilt": h_bytes,
                            "step1_record_facts_jsonl_byte_sha256": rec["byte_sha256"],
                            "fact_list_canonical_sha256": h_list,

           "facts": [{k: f[k] for k in ("fact_id", "exposure", "relation", "stratum")} for f in facts]}
    with open(out_json, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(out, fh, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

"""PILOT_REPORT_ORDER item 3: independent recomputation of the Gate 0 and T1-T3 point estimates and 95% CIs,
and of Delta(L-F), Delta(A-F), from the committed per-fact scores only; comparison with
results/step7_record.json and results/test_evaluation_result.json.

Data Auditor's own script, written new for this task. It does not import, call or copy any Executor code
(metrix/e1-pilot/src/, run_pilot.py, tests/). Standard library + numpy (numpy only for a secondary percentile
self-check). CPU only; no model, no tokenizer, no network. It does not read, generate or look for any TEST data
file (test_qa.jsonl, general_test.jsonl, leakage_test_report.json, <work>/test_details/ ...): the only TEST input
is the committed per-fact score table results/test_evaluation_result.json summaries.<model>.scores_test /
scores_cb, as the order requires.

Definitions used (read from the protocol text and from the interpretations recorded in
results/experiment_record_formal_20261128T045921Z.json environment.interpretations; printed verbatim below):
  protocol 5   Score_split(f) = mean over the questions of f of correct(f, q); Acc = mean of Score over a fact group;
               Acc_CB = mean of CB(f) over the 120 learned facts.
  protocol 6   paired d_f = Score_X(f) - Score_Y(f) on the learned facts; 10,000 replicates; within natural and
               random separately resampled with replacement (60 each); Delta* = mean of the drawn d_f; 95% CI =
               2.5th / 97.5th percentiles; rng_rule(BOOTSTRAP_SEED, '<cmp>:<split>:<seed or avg>'); seed-average
               = per fact the mean of the 3 seeds' Scores, then bootstrap.
  protocol 0   rng_rule = random.Random(int.from_bytes(sha256(f"{SEED}:{purpose}".encode("utf-8")).digest()[:8],
               "big")), BOOTSTRAP_SEED = 20261112, TRAIN_SEEDS = [101, 202, 303].
  B10          one generator per comparison; per replicate, natural then random: r.choices(d_stratum,
               k=len(d_stratum)) with the facts of the stratum in facts.jsonl order; Delta* = mean of 120 values.
  B11          percentile = linear interpolation at position (B - 1) * p / 100 of the sorted replicates.
  B12          purpose '<X>-<Y>:<DEV|TEST>:<seed|avg>'.
  B13          G0.10 sigma_d (ddof 1), its bootstrap with purpose 'sigma:<X>-<Y>:DEV:avg', n = ceil(((1.96 +
               0.84) * sigma / delta)^2), planning n = max, half-width check with purpose
               'halfwidth:<X>-<Y>:DEV:avg:<n>' resampling ceil(n/2) facts per stratum.
  B22          G0.3 'each stratum' = learned accuracy of each stratum; unread checked overall.
  B24          T3 = all four G0.3 ranges (Acc_CB(N) included); TEST purposes use split 'TEST'.
All arithmetic on Scores is exact (fractions.Fraction / integers); square roots for G0.10 use decimal with
60 significant digits. Each recomputed value is compared with the recorded value.
Consistency criterion (fixed before the run): float fields |recorded - mine| <= 1e-12 (difference computed
exactly from the recorded binary float); point_exact fields exact Fraction equality; integers, strings,
booleans and dicts exact equality.
